- Understanding of real-time processing systems (Kafka, Pub/Sub) and CDC (Debezium).

- Preferred certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, AWS Certified Data Engineer or Snowflake SnowPro.

For Analytics Engineers:

- Recommend operational process improvements.

Title: [NLE] Trưởng Bộ Phận Chăm Sóc Khách Hàng
MainDescription:
Job Description

1. Compliance Control:
   - Create and monitor compliance tracking sheets for booths, ensuring all necessary documents are recovered according to regulations.
   - Organize and enforce booth compliance checks, compiling lists of booths, checklists, and coordinating with relevant departments to conduct inspections as planned.
   - Develop corrective action plans and propose solutions when encountering issues.

2. Service Quality Control:
   - Assess booth service quality standards through daily checklists, categorizing recurring errors to plan for corrections and improvements.
   - Inspect the cleanliness, technical equipment, security, staff, product displays, and advertising boards of booths.
   - Maintain a log of ongoing issues, write up work orders, negotiate, and send formal requests for issue resolution, imposing penalties on booths that fail to comply.

3. Management of Rental Contracts and Debt Collection:
   3.1 Management of New Booth Fit-Out:
      - Receive information from new tenants (OTL/HĐT).
      - Coordinate with related departments to inspect premises according to handover conditions, contacting contractors for surveys and cost estimates.
      - Send relevant departments for review and approval of costs and plans to bring the premises up to handover condition, conduct acceptance inspections for renovations, and process payments if applicable.
      - Invite tenants to receive the premises, oversee handover, and notify related departments.
      - Guide design, construction, and supervision processes.
      - Receive designs, provide feedback to tenants, and forward to relevant departments for review/approval, provide feedback on reviews, guide procedures, and sign off on construction documents.
      - Supervise construction according to checklists, ensuring timely and quality completion.
      - Conduct acceptance inspections/complete payment after acceptance.
      - Follow up on tenant feedback, coordinate with related departments for acceptance, monitor resolution progress.
      - Finalize payments after successful acceptance inspection.

   3.2 Support Business Operations of Booths:
      - Collect weekly/monthly revenue data from booths.
      - Monitor and evaluate tenants' business conditions, propose measures to boost their revenue, support marketing campaigns or negotiate reduced rent if necessary.
      - Propose plans to management for approval and implementation after approval.

   3.3 Management of Contract Changes:
      - Amend contract terms when necessary.
      - Renew contracts upon occurrence of relevant events.
      - Liquidate/move booths when required.

   3.4 Management/Debt Collection:
      - Monitor and collect monthly debts:
         + Receive KPIs for debt collection, reconcile debts, issue formal requests to tenants for payment according to regulations.
         + Coordinate with tenants for debt recovery plans, propose solutions to manage booth debt recovery if signs of overdue debt appear, compile tenant plans for management approval, provide feedback to tenants, and monitor progress.
         + Implement necessary measures to recover debts as per the contract.

4. Implementation of Marketing Activities:
   - Propose trade marketing plans.
   - Execute marketing campaigns for the mall/management or booths.

5. Other Tasks as Required:
   - Report periodically on job performance to management.
   - Issue access cards and parking passes for booth staff and visitors.
   - Fully participate in training programs, continuously self-educate and improve professional knowledge and skills to excel in work.

Requirements
- Bachelor's degree or higher in Business Management, Service Management, Tourism-Hotel Management or related fields.
- At least 5 years of experience in customer service within shopping malls, building management, etc.
- Understanding of the entertainment, tourism, hotel, retail, and service industries is an advantage.
- Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
- Data analysis and planning capabilities.
- Customer service mindset and customer experience orientation.

Benefits
Competitive salary and bonuses. Full insurance benefits as per government regulations. Comprehensive health insurance for employees and family members (as per company policy). Opportunities to experience and benefit from a wide range of products and services within the company's ecosystem. Housing, meal, and accommodation support for out-of-town candidates.

     · Coordinate with units to adjust staffing and equipment on the line for optimal results.

Title: Trưởng Phòng Kế Hoạch Vật tư
MainDescription:
Job Description

JOB OBJECTIVE

Responsible for activities related to the company's economic management, budgeting; tender management, contract management, and other investment construction activities in line with the business strategy. Build and maintain a professional, disciplined work environment that fosters employee cohesion. Advise and consult on issues within the scope of the department for the Management Board. Be accountable to the Management Board for the results of the department's assigned functions and tasks.

MAIN DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Planning Work
- Develop and organize the overall supply plan for materials and equipment (M&E) for the entire project across different phases.
- Coordinate with the Project Management Board, EPC contractors, and design consultants to determine M&E requirements.
- Monitor, update progress, and report on the implementation of the supply plan.
- Manage budget planning, material estimates, compare costs, and optimize expenses.

Materials and Procurement Work
- Organize bidding, competitive tendering, and direct procurement according to the Bidding Law and internal management regulations.
- Evaluate suppliers, negotiate M&E procurement contracts.
- Quality control of goods, acceptance, and on-site delivery of materials and equipment.
- Manage inventory, coordinate materials reasonably to ensure construction progress.

Department Management
- Develop internal material procurement management procedures and regulations.
- Manage KHVT staff, assign tasks, and evaluate performance.
- Train, guide, and enhance team capabilities.

External Relations
- Work with domestic and international suppliers.
- Coordinate with customs and logistics for equipment import procedures.
- Collaborate with government agencies as required by the project.

Job Requirements

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
- Minimum Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Commerce, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering or related fields.
- At least 5–7 years of experience in a similar position in construction, power plant, heavy industry, or EPC projects.
- Preference given to those with experience in thermal power, wind power, hydropower, cement, steel, etc. projects.
- Experience in large-scale material planning, international bidding/purchasing, and contract management.

SPECIAL SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE
- Proficient knowledge of the Business Law, Bidding Law, Planning Law, Land Law, Tax Law, and related decrees and circulars.
- Familiarity with procurement processes, logistics, and import/export procedures.
- Understanding of electrical, mechanical, and thermal equipment in the power industry is an advantage.
- Proficient in MS Office, especially Excel; preference for knowledge of material management software.
- Knowledgeable in Project Management, Thermal Power Plant Technology, Bidding Procedures, Contract Management, and Corporate Law.

SKILLS
- Planning and scheduling skills.
- Negotiation and contract negotiation skills.
- Leadership and team management skills.
- Data analysis and cost optimization skills.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS
- Good health, willing to work at project sites.
- Logical thinking, careful, honest.
- Preference for candidates who have worked for major investors or EPC contractors.

BENEFITS
- Competitive salary based on capability.
- Project progress and performance bonuses.
- Opportunities for advancement and involvement in large-scale projects.
- Social insurance, health insurance, accommodation at the project site according to company regulations.
- Friendly and professional working environment with long-term development opportunities.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS AND SUBMISSION FORMATS
- Relevant certificates and diplomas.
- Location of work: An Khanh Thermal Power Joint Stock Company - Bac Giang, Thon Dam - Xa Cam Ly - Bac Ninh Province.

Job Description

Functional responsibilities include overseeing project implementation and construction management. Conduct site condition surveys, measurements, budgeting, and design drawings. Sign contracts with contractors. Monitor store construction according to blueprints, technical standards, and internal guidelines. Control construction progress and provide early warnings of potential delays.

2. Quality & Technical Management
Inspect material quality, equipment, and construction methods. Identify and request corrections for technical errors. Ensure the project meets acceptance criteria and stable operation requirements.

Nurture project completion and handover: Inspect each section and complete final inspections. Prepare inspection reports and handover checklists. Finalize payments to contractors. Coordinate handover with relevant departments.

3. Contractor Management
Track, evaluate contractor capabilities and compliance. Suggest replacing or improving contractors if quality is unsatisfactory. Control post-handover warranty implementation.

4. Maintenance & Repair
Receive and process maintenance requests. Prioritize fault reports and propose technical solutions. Directly handle simple technical issues if necessary. Coordinate external repair teams. Monitor repair progress and quality. Pay repair costs.

5. Cost Control
Propose appropriate repair costs within the budget. Control cost overruns and minimize repeated repairs. Summarize maintenance costs by store. Inspect and verify post-repair results, ensuring safety and stable operation. Confirm completion and inspect repaired quantities. Analyze root causes to prevent recurrence.

Standardize technical standards across the chain. Propose design, material, and equipment standards according to industry norms and time periods (e.g., ESG). Standardize vulnerable details to reduce maintenance costs. Update and improve technical checklists.

6. Accident Prevention
Analyze common faults and accidents. Propose preventive solutions. Participate in new project, repair, and maintenance process improvements.

7. Reporting & Data Tracking
Report on new construction and renovation progress. Track maintenance status: quantity, cost, and handling time. Monitor quality and efficiency KPIs.

8. Inter-departmental Coordination
Work with Sales, Legal, Procurement, and Administration. Provide technical support for permits and inspections. Participate in new site risk assessments.

9. Compliance & Safety
Ensure construction and repairs comply with legal regulations. Control on-site labor safety. Identify and address safety risks.

Job Description

JOB OBJECTIVE
Manage and oversee all activities related to Quality Management, Software Testing, and Process Control to ensure that software products meet high quality standards, are delivered on time, and comply with the software development standards set by the Company.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Build and Manage Quality System Processes and Regulations:
   - Develop, standardize, and manage software development lifecycle (SDLC), software testing lifecycle (STLC) processes, and guidelines (SOP, Work Instructions).
   - Ensure quality system processes comply with international standards such as ISO 9001, Agile/Scrum Best Practices, DevOps, ISO/IEC 27001 (Security), etc.
   - Design and implement QA/QC processes suitable for Agile models (Scrum, Kanban) and DevOps to ensure continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery (CD).
   - Build a quality testing framework that supports both manual and automated testing in CI/CD pipelines.
   - Integrate testing tools into the DevOps system (Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI) to automate testing processes and reporting.
   - Organize periodic evaluations and improvements of processes to enhance efficiency, optimize costs, and ensure product quality.

2. Manage Software Testing Activities:
   - Develop software testing strategies and plans for projects: Unit Test, Integration Test, System Test, Regression Test, UAT.
   - Lead staff in designing, executing, and reporting test cases, including functional, non-functional, performance, security, and API testing.
   - Directly participate in testing as a Test lead for critical and important projects.
   - Apply modern testing frameworks like Cypress, Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, or Appium (for mobile testing) to ensure multi-platform testing.
   - Deploy and maintain performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling to assess load capacity and optimize product performance.
   - Use defect management and testing tools to track progress and quality of testing.
   - Monitor the testing process, analyze, and report test results to ensure early detection and resolution of issues.
   - Collaborate closely with development teams (Developers), Business Analysts (BA), Project Managers (PM) to control quality throughout the development lifecycle.

3. Promote Test Automation:
   - Develop automated testing procedures, select, and deploy tools such as Selenium, Katalon, JMeter, Postman, etc.
   - Build and maintain automated test suites for web applications, mobile applications, and microservices using languages like Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, PHP, C#, etc.
   - Integrate automated testing tools into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous and rapid testing throughout development stages.
   - Evaluate and deploy AI/ML technologies in testing (e.g., Testim, Mabl) to optimize error detection and automate test scenario creation.

4. Manage Internal Evaluations and Compliance Assurance:
   - Organize internal process audit activities to ensure projects comply with procedures.
   - Control compliance of projects with security requirements and quality standards.

5. Manage Quality Performance & Continuous Improvement:
   - Develop a system for measuring and reporting quality performance metrics (Quality KPIs): Defect Density, Defect Leakage, Test Coverage, Test Execution Rate, Automation Coverage, etc.
   - Use data analysis tools like ELK Stack, Grafana, Splunk, etc., to visualize and monitor quality performance.
   - Analyze quality data, provide recommendations for improvement, and develop specific action plans.
   - Prepare regular reports for the Board of Directors, recommend improvements based on data analysis and technology trends.
   - Develop a "Quality Excellence" program and promote a culture of quality throughout the organization.

6. Manage Teams & Quality Capability Development:
   - Plan human resources, organize recruitment, training, and development of QA/Tester teams.
   - Evaluate employee performance, guide career development paths for QA department staff. This includes obtaining certifications like ISTQB Advanced Level, Certified Agile Tester, or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer.
   - Organize quality awareness training, processes, and testing for related departments.
   - Guide employees on new testing technologies, frameworks such as Pytest, Robot Framework, Katalon Studio, etc.
   - Organize knowledge-sharing sessions on Agile Testing, Test-Driven Development (TDD), DevOps practices, etc.

- Đã từng tham gia vào phát triển các team dự án, team phát triển sản phẩm cho ít nhất 02 sản phẩm/giải pháp CNTT ra thị trường.
- Ứng viên đã có kinh nghiệm lead team đội nhóm, tổ trưởng đội nhóm là lợi thế.
- Có kinh nghiệm trong các lĩnh vực doanh nghiệp số, chính phủ điện tử hoặc các dự án chuyển đổi số cho khách hàng B2B/B2G là lợi thế.
- Am hiểu các nền tảng công nghệ liên quan (phần mềm, nền tảng số, hạ tầng điện toán đám mây, bảo mật…) để có thể định hướng thiết kế sản phẩm.
- Am hiểu các công cụ quản lý sản phẩm, phân tích dữ liệu người dùng.
- Có khả năng áp dụng và xây dựng các quy trình quản trị phát triển phần mềm phù hợp với yêu cầu triển khai hệ thống CNTT trong doanh nghiệp lớn và cơ quan Nhà nước.
- Kỹ năng giao tiếp và trình bày tốt, có khả năng giải thích các vấn đề kỹ thuật cho lãnh đạo và đối tác không chuyên về CNTT.
- Có khả năng làm việc độc lập, đồng thời phối hợp tốt với các nhóm kỹ thuật khác.
- Tiếng Anh tốt để đọc tài liệu kỹ thuật và trao đổi chuyên môn quốc tế là lợi thế.
- Học vấn: Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên chuyên ngành Công nghệ Thông tin, Khoa học Máy tính, Toán Tin hoặc các ngành liên quan. Ưu tiên bằng Thạc sĩ/Chuyên ngành cao về Công nghệ hoặc Quản lý Sản phẩm.
- Chứng chỉ: Ưu tiên chứng chỉ quản lý dự án (PMP/Prince2) hoặc các khóa đào tạo quản trị sản phẩm chuyên nghiệp (Product Manager, Scrum Master…). Chứng chỉ công nghệ (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, v.v.) là lợi thế.
Job_Benefits:
- Thu nhập cạnh tranh: mức lương và thưởng hấp dẫn, thỏa thuận dựa trên năng lực và kết quả. Định kỳ xem xét, điều chỉnh thu nhập. Thưởng các dịp lễ, cuối năm.
- Chế độ phúc lợi: đầy đủ BHXH, BHYT, BHTN theo Luật Lao động, kèm bảo hiểm sức khỏe nâng cao. Chế độ nghỉ phép, nghỉ lễ theo quy định, cộng thêm các phúc lợi nội bộ (du lịch, teambuilding, hội thao, v.v.).
- Trang bị công cụ, phần mềm, nền tảng công nghệ hiện đại để phát triển sản phẩm.
- Được tham gia vào các chương trình đào tạo và phát triển chuyên môn (workshop, đào tạo nội bộ, học tập công nghệ mới), có chính sách khen thưởng, hỗ trợ chi phí học tập các chứng chỉ quốc tế tế cao cấp/chứng chỉ chuyên môn cao cấp.
- Cơ hội làm việc với các dự án B2G quy mô lớn, cung cấp sản phẩm, dịch vụ hoặc giải pháp cho các cơ quan, tổ chức chính phủ, tiếp cận những xu hướng công nghệ/nền tảng mới nhất.
- Môi trường trẻ trung, năng động, minh bạch, văn hóa làm việc chuyên nghiệp, cơ hội hợp tác với đối tác chiến lược, tập đoàn công nghệ trong và ngoài nước.
